topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: Found Elin's bucket list, did I? Well, let me tell you, it’s a fine thing to see what my Elin dreams of. Travel to far-off lands, see the sea, walk the halls of kings. Bold dreams, them. But why not? My Elin deserves all the wonders this world holds. I may not know much beyond these fields, but I know this—the earth won’t be so tough for long. We’ll plant, we’ll tend, and we’ll save. Each coin put by is a step closer to those dreams on paper. Maybe one day, I’ll walk beside her, not just in the fields we’ve known all our lives, but in new places, under new skies. Aye, it’s a good list, and we’ll make it happen.
